name: 10e-convert-ai21-messages
description: convertAI21Messages (prompt-converters.js:631-695) on a full prompt. Three observable rules: (1) the leading run of system turns is drained into ONE system prompt joined with '\n\n' and then trimmed (:654, :670) -- the trailing separator is why the trim matters -- and spliced out of the caller's array (:657, so `mutated` shows the drain); (2) the two example names are prefixed at :643-653 and then every remaining `name` is consumed and deleted at :674-682, with the non-system turns receiving the 'name: ' prefix; (3) the alternating-turn merge at :684-692 is UNCONDITIONAL on content -- unlike mergeMessages it has no truthiness test on `message.content`, which is why the empty user turn still merges into the preceding user turn instead of becoming its own message. A user turn, an assistant turn and a user turn are added after the system run so the merge covers both halves.
